Container.Name: plex-language-sync
Container.Overview:
Remembers the audio and subtitle languages you pick for each TV show in Plex and sets them on every other episode, for each user of your server.
Sets your choice on the rest of the show as soon as you pick it on one episode, and gives new episodes the same tracks when Plex adds them. It learns which subtitles you pair with each audio language and sets them on new shows. It chooses between the tracks your files already have and downloads nothing. No web UI, no open port.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex audio subtitle language track auto-languages
Container.Requires: Plex URL: the full URL of your Plex server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400. Use the server's LAN IP, not a container name. Plex Token: the server administrator's token. Plex's guide Finding an authentication token shows where to find it: https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/ Multi-user support fetches shared user tokens from plex.tv, so the container needs internet access. Raise the Docker stop time-out to 20 seconds or more (Settings, Docker, advanced view) so the final cache save completes on stop.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator. Plex's guide: https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436-finding-an-authentication-token-x-plex-token/

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent cache of learned language profiles, shared-user tokens and sync state

Config.Name: Update level
Config.Description: Scope of language propagation: show applies to all episodes of the show, season only to the current season

Config.Name: Update strategy
Config.Description: Which episodes to update: all updates every episode in scope, next only the episodes after the one being played

Config.Name: Trigger on play
Config.Description: React to playback events: playing an episode propagates its language settings

Config.Name: Trigger on scan
Config.Description: React to library scans: newly added or updated episodes get each user's recorded selection for the show

Config.Name: Learn language profiles
Config.Description: Learn audio-to-subtitle language pairs from playback and apply them to brand new shows with no watch history

Config.Name: Subtitle match tier
Config.Description: How far a subtitle substitution may reach when no exact language match exists: identical, same-language, other-script, intelligible or shared-literacy

Config.Name: Deep scan interval
Config.Description: How often the deep-scan safety net runs, as a Go duration such as 24h or 12h. off turns it off

Config.Name: Ignore labels
Config.Description: Comma-separated Plex labels that exclude a show from language sync. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, and setting this replaces the defaults

Config.Name: Ignore libraries
Config.Description: Comma-separated Plex library names to exclude entirely. Matching is exact and case-sensitive

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error. debug shows why each event was skipped and how streams were matched

Config.Name: Plex CA certificate path
Config.Description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate. The path of the CA PEM file inside the container, with a matching path mapping
